post.summary:
Gets the worktime data for Period recalculation from raw calc, holidays andabsences data.
These determine how holiday salaries etc. and absence deductions will be added as rows to calculations.
The idea is that user can still modify these before the actual calculation is done as often manual adjustments need to be made.
Also, providers that do not use HolidayYears and Absences can skip this step and use recalculate-worktime directly.
NOTE: This is the anonymous method that can be called without storage.
There is a corresponding method in Calculations-service that fetches the holidayYear and Absences automatically.

requestBody.description: The salary calculation that should be recalculated and the holidays and absences that should be added to it.

Expenses, Benefits, deductions etc. Note that side costs are not rows.

Date of birth for the Worker - this affects the side costs. 
Please also set the DateOfBirthAccuracy, if you set this property.
If PaymentData or AccountId lead to a valid Social security number, it will override any age set here.

- typically the workflow from draft to Payment.

salaryPaidAt.description: Time when the salary was paid by Palkkaus service.

repairedAt.description: Last date and time when this calculation was repaired after payment.

salaryDate.description: The estimated date when the salary is withdrawable by the worker.

requestedSalaryDate.description: The requested date for the SalaryDate from the employer.

originalId.description: The original id the calculation which this calculation is a copy of.

amount.description: Amount of e.g. hours, months for the salary. Default is 1.

price.description: Price of one unit - e.g. hour, month.

unit.description: E.g. hour, month. Typically this parameter can be left empty/null and the unit is set according to type.

message.description: Optional message for the salary row that is shown in reports. If null, will be set according to type.

isHouseholdDeductible.description: If set to true, will calculate the household deduction. Applies only to natural persons - as oppsed to companies.

UserDefinedRow.description:
This is a user defined calculation row as opposed to CalculationRow that may 
be either based on a user defined row or generated by the system based on e.g. TES parameters.

rowIndex.description:
Zero based row index that can be used to match the row to result rows or when deleting.
NOTE: The Row ID is given values on the fly so setting this will not have any effect at the moment.
It may reorder the entries in later implementations.

type.description:
Wage type. Either a built in wage type in Salaxy or a custom wage type created by the user.
Please note that this type fully determines the <see cref="T:Palkkaus.Model.Calc.CalculationRowType"></see> and the kind.

message.description: Description text of the row that is shown in reports. If null, will be set according to type.

count.description: Count for the row - default is one

sourceId.description:
Identifier in the source system is a key defined by a source system / partner system.
This is a pass-through string that is passed to the result calculations.

isTesIncludedInSalary.description: Marker that the payments defined by framework agreement are included in the salary (will not be added by the calculation).

numberOfDays.description: Number of days may affect calculation of different payments calculated based on a Framework agreement

dailyTravelExpensesKm.description: The amount of kilometers travelled by day - used to define the amount of travel expenses in aomse framework agreements.

isYksityisenHoidonTuki.description: If true will calculate the Finnish child care subsidy

yksityisenHoidonTukiAmount.description: Amount of Finnish child care subsidy

A usecase for creating and editing salary calculations and other .
In practice, a usecase is either a user interface or a microservice that provides the bases for the object.
Provides the possibility to store useacase specific data as part of object.
NOTE: For Calculations, this functionality will replace TesParameters in the 3.0 version.

uri.description:
Key for the usecase based on which it is resolved. 
Later, this may resolve to a user interface, microservice or a to manifest registering one.
For now, just use a unique string starting with a domain you own.

label.description: A short label of that can be shown to the end user.

description.description:
Optional description of the use case for the end user.
Shown in detail views when explaining the logic of the usecase.

irRows.description:
Rows that are compatible with Incomes Register (tulorekisteri) process.
These are available only for calculations paid after 7.2.2019 (TODO: estimation as of writing).

rows.description: The result rows. Note that this collection also contains the main Salary entry as one of the rows.

salarySlipMessage.description: Message which will be displayed in the payslip.

paymentId.description: Payment reference number in payment service

irSenderOfficialId.description: Earnings Payment Report Official id of the sender.

applicationId.description: Application id for invoicing etc. purposes.

messageThreadId.description: The MessageThread Id, if this calculation is referred in a message thread.

reportDate.description: Assumed earnings payment report date for the report.

backofficeNotes.description:
Notes related to the payment and other backoffice operations: 
For example the justification why the sum is in calculation vs. Paytrail payment.

For Finnish Salaries use the Statistics Finland 
"Classification of Occupations 2010" (TK10): https://www.stat.fi/meta/luokitukset/ammatti/017-2018-05-15/index_en.html

occupationCode2.description: Secondary occupation classification. Some earnings payment reports may require two occupation codes.

payrollId.description: The Payroll Id, if this calculation is part of a Payroll list.

workerSourceId.description:
Identifier of the worker in a source system. Used in imports etc.
This is automatically set from the source id of the employment.

sourceId.description: Identifier of the calculation in a source system. Used in imports etc.

lastSharedCc.description: Email address which the calculation was shared as cc last time.

lastSharedMessage.description: Last shared message to the employer

work days, absences, holidays and holiday accrual.
In the future may also contain relevant part of timesheet data (work hours).

leavesDailySalary.description: Price for a single holiday day

bonusDailySalary.description: Price for a single bonus day

holidayPayAccrualRemaining.description: Total remaining amount of holiday pay accrual.

holidayBonusAccrualRemaining.description: Total remaining amount of holiday bonus accrual.

accruals.description: Accruals for each calendar month in this calculation.

HOWEVER: The getter will change the string to upper invariant/trim and if the last character is "*", it will be replaced by calculated checksum.

socialSecurityNumberValid.description: Social security number if valid or null

ibanNumber.description: IBAN number for the Bank account

CalcTax.description: Tax card information stored as part of the Calculation object

taxcardId.description:
Identifier for a stored tax card if one is applied to this calculation.
System updates the TaxCardId automatically in Recalculate / Save if it finds a better candidate
and also updates the Snapshot.

fixedTaxAmount.description:
Possibility to set a fixed widthholding tax amount for this calculation regardless of 
the percentage etc. in the tax card.

isValid.description:
The API returns true if there is a valid taxcard for the PaidAt date for this calculation
or if FixedTaxAmount is set for th calculation.

estimatedTax.description:
Calculated widthholding tax. Note that this is an estimation until the calculation is actually paid.
Also, if the salary is not paid as cash (e.g. fringe benefits), there may not be enough money to make the full deduction.

hasNewSharedCard.description: A flag that during last recalculation, there was a new shared taxcard that was waiting approval.

taxPercentForVisualization.description:
Tax percent that is used in visualization. This is mainly used in Unit testing and anonymous calcultors.
Not used in real paid calculations. This is percent. I.e. for 50% set 50, not 0.5.
If PaymentData or AccountId lead to a valid tax card type and percent, or if there is FixedTaxAmount, this value is not used.

RowAccounting.description: Provides row specific data for accounting (both cost and financial accounting).

vatPercent.description: Percent for VAT calculation expressed as decimal: 24% is 0.24.

vatEntries.description:
Total VAT amount splitted by VAT rates.
Please note, that if both {Palkkaus.Model.Calc.RowAccounting.VatPercent} and the {Palkkaus.Model.Calc.RowAccounting.VatEntries} with some entries given,
the {Palkkaus.Model.Calc.RowAccounting.VatEntries} are applied.
Please note that this is null by default.

totalUnemploymentInsuranceBase.description: Base income for calculating the Unemployment insurance contributions.

totalHealthInsuranceBase.description: Base income for calculating the Health insurance contributions.

totalAccidentInsuranceBase.description: Base income for calculating the Accident insurance contributions.

This is the Gross sum before side costs, deductions etc., but it is not Gross salary as it includes expenses etc.

Models the business logic of Employer side of the calculation. 
For documentation, see the IEmployerCalculation interface.

allSideCosts.description: All side cost: The mandatory side costs + Palkkaus and partner fees

finalCost.description:
The final cost after household decuction from the tax authorities:
Add to the payment the deductions (paid by employer) and deduct House hold deduction (later potentially other such subsidies)

householdDeduction.description:
Household deduction that the tax man will reimburse in taxation.
This is an estimation: There is minimum and maximum limits etc.

mandatorySideCosts.description: The mandatory side costs are Pension (TyEL), Social secuirty and Unemployment insurance.

palkkaus.description: The Palkkaus.fi fee including potential partner fees.

service.description: Extra service charge in addition to Palkkaus fee.

pension.description: The part of the Pension that Employer pays

socialSecurity.description: The social security payment- paid as part of taxation (ennakonpidätys).

totalPayment.description: Total payment that is Paid to Palkkaus.fi

totalPaymentLegacy.description:
Total payment using pre Insiders register calculation logic.
DEPRICATED: This is provided for special scenarios and may be removed without warning

totalSalaryCost.description: Total salary cost is the paid salary, deductions and side costs, but not expenses.

unemployment.description: The part of the unemployment insurance that the employer pays

totalDeductions.description: Total deductions that are made from the payment that is paid to Palkkaus and then to Worker

deductionUnionPayment.description: Union payment if it is deducted from the final figure

deductionPensionSelfPayment.description: Pension payments, when paid directly by the Employer - not by Palkkaus.fi

deductionUnemploymentSelfPayment.description: Unemployment insurance (TVR) payments, when paid directly by the Employer - not by Palkkaus.fi

deductionSalaryAdvance.description: Salary advance - this part has already been paid.

deductionForeclosure.description: Foreclosure that has already been paid by the employer.

deductionTaxAndSocialSecuritySelfPayment.description: Tax and social security payments, when paid directly by the Employer - not by Palkkaus.fi

deductionWorkerSelfPayment.description: Worker salary and expense payments, when paid directly by the Employer - not by Palkkaus.fi

foreclosureByPalkkaus.description: Foreclosure that Palkkaus.fi pays in behalf of employer.

deductionOtherDeductions.description: Other deductions that are deducted from the net salary.

WorkerCalculationDTO.description:
The Worker side of the calculation.
SalarySlip is largely written based on this calculation.

benefits.description: The benefits as valued by the tax authority.

deductions.description:
All the items that are deducted from the salary (this is also the order if there is not enough payable money):
SalaryAdvance + Tax + Pension + UnemploymentInsurance + UnionPayment + OtherDeductions

salaryPayment.description:
The payment that is made to the Worker based on salary after all deductions.
Does not include expenses.

salaryAdvance.description: The salary advance that was paid to the Worker

foreclosure.description: The foreclosure that been deducted from the salary by the employer.

tax.description: Ennakonpidätys: The taxes that were deducted from the worker salary.

taxAtSource.description: Lähdevero: The tax at source that were deducted from the worker salary.

salaryAfterTax.description: Net salary after tax - before worker foreclosure or deductions of the side costs

salaryAfterTaxAndForeclosure.description: Net salary after tax and foreclosure.

pension.description: Part of the Pension that is taken from the Worker side of the salary.

unemploymentInsurance.description: Workers part of the unemployment insurance.

socialSecurity.description: The social security payment. NOT paid as a part of tax withhold .

unionPayment.description: The union payment that is deducted from the Worker salarya s per workers request.

fullTax.description: Widthholding tax: The original calulated version - there might not be enough money to finally pay this.

fullTaxAtSource.description: Tax at source: The original calulated version - there might not be enough money to finally pay this.

fullSalaryAdvance.description:
The salary advance that was paid to the Worker
The original calulated version - there might not be enough money to finally pay this.

fullPension.description:
Part of the Pension that is taken from the Worker side of the salary.
The original calulated version - there might not be anough money to finally pay this.

fullUnemploymentInsurance.description:
Workers part of the unemployment insurance.
The original calulated version - there might not be anough money to finally pay this.

fullSocialSecurity.description:
The social security payment. NOT paid as a part of tax withhold .
The original calculted version.

fullUnionPayment.description: The union payment that is deducted from the Worker salarya s per workers request.

totalWorkerPayment.description:
The sum that is at the end paid to the Worker:
Salary payment + expenses

totalWorkerPaymentLegacy.description:
Total payment using pre Insiders register calculation logic.
DEPRICATED: This is provided for special scenarios and may be removed without warning

workerSideCosts.description:
The side costs that are deducted from the Worker salary according to law:
Pension, Unemployment and Union payment. Tax is not included in this number.
This is not an official number, really used in the charts etc.

fullOtherDeductions.description:
Other deductions that are deducted from the net salary.
The original calulated version - there might not be enough money to finally deduct this.

otherDeductions.description: Part of the other deductions that are deducted from the net salary.

fullPrepaidExpenses.description:
Prepaid expenses that are deducted from the expenses to be paid to the worker.
The original calulated version - there might not be enough money to finally deduct this.

prepaidExpenses.description: Part of the prepaid expenses that are deducted from the expenses.

If the row is generated by calculation business logic (e.g. based on framework agreement), the index is -1.

totalBaseSalary.description: Base salary (Peruspalkka) is the monthly salary or total salary without addiotions (overtime, holidays etc.)

totalGrossSalary.description: Gross salary (Bruttopalkka) is "real" salary including the additions (overtime, holidays etc.) but not benefits.

totalTaxable.description: Taxable income (Ennakonpidätyksen alainen ansio) is the salary from taxation point-of-view. It is basically the Gross Salary plus benefits.

totalSocialSecurityBase.description:
Social Security Base (Sosiaaliturvan alainen ansio) is typically the same as TotalTaxable, 
but e.g. child care subsidy (yksityisen hoidon tuki) is handled differently.

totalDeduction.description: Deductions from the salary: Union payment, Advance, Foreclosure

sourceId.description:
Identifier in the source system is a key defined by a source system / partner system.
This is a pass-through string that is kept as-is in the Salaxy system.

IEmployerResponsibilities.description:
Parameters that affect the calculation. 
EmployerResponsibilities is historical name - currentlty to object holds also other properties 
that are not well described as responsibilities.
These based on the EmployerGroups selection or properties of the Employer and Worker snapshots as well as this Calculation

noPensionPayment.description:
Pension is not paid if the salary to this Worker is less than a certain amount in a month (about 60€)
or worker is less than 17 or more than 64 years old.

noSocialSecurity.description: If worker is less than 16 or more than 67, social secuiry payment is not paid

noTvr.description:
If Worker is less than 17 or more than 64, TVR is not paid.
Also if the Employer has no accident insurance.

insurancePercent.description: Percent for calculating the estimate for the accident insurance amount to pay.

groupLifeInsurancePercent.description: Percent for calculating the estimate for the group life insurance amount to pay.

pensionOldAgePayment.description:
If the Worker is from 53 to 62 years old, more of the Pension payment 
is deducted from the Worker side of the salary (less for the Employer).
NOTE: People from 63 to 67 years pay the same amount as 17-52 years old.

pensionRegularEmployer.description:
The employer should have a Pension contract (not a temporary employer).
It does not necessarily mean that the user has a contract yet.
NOTE: At the moment, this is not used for calculation - only in the Side costs visualizer tool.

isPensionMonthlyContract.description:
If true, the employer has a Pension contract and makes the payments 
in a monthly schedule which means that Pension interest is calculated for the 20th of the next month.
Currently, this is only enabled to Etera - other companies will follow.

unemploymentSelfPayment.description:
If true, the employer pays the Unemployment insurance directly to TVR.
As of writing, this is true for all companies and with calculations starting 1.8.2018,
false for households or calculations before the date.

calculationPaymentDate.description:
The assumed salary payment date from the worker perspective.
The system calculates the nearest possible salary date if no any salary date has been given by the
employer. If given, the system confirms the given date.
This date affects the yearly percents used in the salary calculation.

workerDateOfBirth.description:
Date of birth for the Worker - this affects the side costs. 
Please also set the DateOfBirthAccuracy, if you set this property.
If SocialSecurityNumber is set, it will override any value set here.

irIncomeEarnerTypes.description: Type of additional income earner data by National Incomer Register classification . If several types apply, all of them should be selected.

subOrgCode.description: Sub organization code for the Incomes Registry.

employmentRegCode.description: Employment registration code for Incomes Registry.

taxAndSocialSecuritySelfPayment.description: Tax and social security payments are paid directly by the Employer - not by Palkkaus.fi

workerSelfPayment.description: Worker salary and expense payments are paid directly by the Employer - not by Palkkaus.fi

pensionSelfPayment.description: Pension payments are paid directly by the Employer - not by Palkkaus.fi

salarySlipDeliveryMethods.description: Options for the delivery of the payslip to the worker.

ApiValidation.description: Common base class / interface for data validation.

hasAllRequiredFields.description: If true, has required fields missing data.

errors.description:
Validation errors on invalid field values. 
Note that required fields missing error messages are not here. Only the invalid values.

CostAccountingDimension.description: Id of the cost accounting dimension with optional percentage for shared costs.

HolidaySpecificationForYear.description: Extends the Holiday specification with the properties of employment relation that are required for a specific year.

accrualFixed.description:
Defines the number of holidays that the worker is entitled per month worked.
If the value is set to 0 (default), the number is 2 for first year and 2,5 thereafter as defined in the law.
To actually se the daysPerMonth to zero, use code value other than Permanent14Days or Permanent35Hours.

compensation.description:
For {Palkkaus.Model.Worktime.Holidays.HolidayPayCalculation.HolidayCompensation} the compensation percent.
Holiday compensation as percent of salary (11.5% is 0.115)

holidayPayPercent.description:
For {Palkkaus.Model.Worktime.Holidays.HolidayPayCalculation.PercentageBasedPay} the percent.
Holiday pay as percent of salary (11.5% is 0.115)

bonus.description:
Holiday bonus for the worker (lomaraha, lomaltapaluuraha).
Typically 0.5 for 50%.

MonthlyHolidayAccrual.description: Holiday Accrual for a calendar month in releation to a calculation.

month.description: First day of month for the holiday month

daysAccrued.description:
Holiday accrual for this month.
Note that -1 is indication that accrual should not be updated for this particylar month.
There is no possiblity for negative accrual.

absencesDays.description: Number of absence days used in the calculation.

workDays.description: Work days in determining the accrual for the month in 14 days rule.

workHours.description: Work hours in determining the accrual fot the month in 35 hour rule.

calcId.description: Id of the calculation that this accrual is related to.

HolidayAccrualCalcSpecification.description: Info covering most important accrual year parameters.

defaultAccrual.description: Default accrual for months where the Accrual occurs.

TaxcardSnapshot.description:
Basic information about the taxcard: This object has the information printed in SalarySlip etc. 
but not the full salaries paid to the taxcard etc.

forYear.description: Year that the tax card is valid for. Typically this means from February of this year to January of the following.

taxPercent.description: Tax percent as percent. I.e. for 50% set 50, not 0.5.

incomeLimit.description:
Income up to which the TaxPercent can be used.
Any income above the limit is taxed with ExcessTaxPercent.

cumulativeIncome.description:
Cumulative income on the taxcard - including this calculation.
Note that with shared taxcards, this may include income from other employers.

taxPercent2.description:
Tax percentage that is used in calculating the widthholding tax for the part of income above the IncomeLimit.
This is percent. I.e. for 50% set 50, not 0.5.

taxPercentMin.description:
A Worker may request a minimum percent that is deducted even if the effective tax percent would be lower.
This can be used if Worker knows that he/she will be earning more in the year than what was estimated when the taxcard was created.

taxPercentMinOwned.description:
TaxPercentMin set by owner of the card.
This overrides the tax percent min set by the taxcard sharer.

fileUri.description:
Uri to the file copy of the tax card. 
Set by the system as part of the upload process, do not change in the API though it may be technically possible. This may have unintended results.

previewUri.description:
Uri to the preview image of the tax card. 
Set by the system as part of the upload process, do not change in the API though it may be technically possible. This may have unintended results.

lastChecked.description:
Explicit value of when the item was last checked. At the moment, updated in API fetches only, but may be used later for other checks.
Undefined value is 1.1.2000

VatEntry.description: For VAT breakdown of a receipt (ALV-erittely) represents a single VAT rate and the revenue and tax with that rate.

tax.description:
Tax amount of specific VAT rate in euro.
This value is mandatory, if the collection of VatEntries contains more than one item.

taxPercent.description: Tax as percent of Net sales (0-1). Currently just informative, but may later be used for Custom non-standard VAT rates.

gross.description:
Gross sales for specific VAT rate including the tax (VAT).
This value is mandatory, if the collection of VatEntries contains more than one item.

net.description:
Net sales for specific VAT rate excluding the tax (VAT).
This value is mandatory, if the collection of VatEntries contains more than one item.

The value should be null if the row is not mealBenefit.

CarBenefit.description:
Car benefit

Mandatory data group, if the income type is "Car benefit". This data group may not be used with other income types.

kilometers.description:
Odometer reading

The value must be greater than or equal to 0

emissionsValue.description:
Car emissions value

The car emissions value must be greater than or equal to 0, and smaller than or
equal to 100. The car emissions value can only be reported if the payment date
or other reporting date is in 2022–2025.

Saving with this status also makes the employment relation Archived.

Typically used for setting for example monthly salary or hourly salary price for workers.

monthlyHours.description: Number of hours per month defined in the employment contract.

Contains values that are needed when creating an employment, but where changing is restricted in the future:
E.g. names and personalId are required when creating a new employment, but once a calculation is created (or at least paid),
editing of theses is no longer possible. See the editing rules for individual properties.

firstName.description:
First name of the Worker. Value is required when creating a new employment, it cannot be modified after initial create:
Instead you should just delete the Worker (only allowed if no paid salaries etc.) and create a new one.

lastName.description: Last name of the worker. Editing rules are the same as with FirstName.

personalId.description: Personal ID (hetu) of the worker (currently required). Editing rules are the same as with FirstName.

avatarImg.description:
Avatar picture. If set, this is used in avatar instead of Initials (automatic FirstName/LastName) and color.
May be changed until the Worker registers to the service. After this, the Worker can upload their own image or choose to remove the image.

start.description:
The start date/time of the event.
NOTE, unlike in iCalendar, in our model Start is always required and then either End or Duration is used to determine the duration.

end.description:
The end date/time of the event.
Note that if Duration is set, it will override this property whenever saved or recalculated.

duration.description:
The duration of the event. 
Note that if set to something else than null / zero, this property will always override the End date/datetime.

isAllDay.description: Returns true if the event is an all-day event: Start and End are dates ("yyyy-MM-dd"), not date-times ("yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss").

priority.description:
Priority is specified as an integer in the range 0 to 9.
A value of 0 specifies an undefined priority.
A value of 1 is the highest priority, 1-4=HIGH, 5=MEDIUM/Normal and 6-9=LOW.
Negative values may be used by admin functions (not through API) to set priority overrides.

CalendarAction.description:
Salaxy calendar action is an extension to iCalendar Alarms:
It supports the standard alarms: Display, Email and Audio, but also salaxy action scripts.

Script actions may also later use them when credentials, accounts or similar are needed fro execution.

triggerDateTime.description:
The fixed date-time trigger. Only used if, Duration is not available.
NOTE that Salaxy implements this feature a bit differently than rfc-5545: The spec says that for a repeating event, 
the alarm should trigger only once (+repeat), but current Salaxy implementation would trigger the alarm the amount of items.

repeat.description:
If specified, the action repeats number of times (in addition to the initial trigger) specified in this parameter with RepeatDuration values.
If Repeat is more than 0, also RepeatDuration must be specified.

PayrollDetails.description:
New version 03 of Payroll. Payroll (Palkkalista) is a list of employees who receive salary or wages from a particular organization.
Typical usecase is that a a company has e.g. a monthly salary list that is paid
at the end of month. For next month, a copy is then made from the latest list and
the copy is potentially modified with the changes of that particular month.

calcs.description: Snapshots of the calculations based on the ID's specified in Info

validations.description:
When saved or validated, provides a validation object for each calculation:
Whether the calculations are ready for payment.

createdAt.description: The date when the object was created.

updatedAt.description:
The time when the object was last updated. 
Typically this should be a logical update by user (UserUpdatedAt in DTO), not technical updates.

isReadOnly.description: Indication that for the currently logged-in account, the data is generally read-only.

partner.description: Primary partner information. Automatically updated from the storage container Partner.

PayrollInput.description: Input that user defines about the Payroll

title.description: Title that can be specified by the end user.

salaryDate.description: The requested date for the SalaryDate from the employer.

noUpdateFromEmployment.description:
If true, the calculation rows are not updated from employment when the Payroll is copied.
Default is that the rows and other data is updated in copy / create new etc.

template.description:
If the Payroll is based on a template, this is the identifier of the template.
The field can be manually set to null / ID to break / reconnect that connection.

sourceId.description: Identifier of the payroll in a source system. Used in imports etc.

Payroll03Info.description:
Provides Read-only information about the Payroll
In the case of non-paid Payrolls, this is the latest save/validation.
In the case of paid Payrolls, this is the status of the Payroll when it was paid.

calcCount.description: Count of calculations in this Payroll

fees.description: Total Palkkaus.fi fees for the Payroll

isReadyForPayment.description:
If true, all calculations have been validated and they are valid for payment.
If false, validation has not been done or some calculations are not valid for payment.

dueDate.description: Due date for the payroll. Date when the payment should be made to achieve SalaryDate.

paymentDate.description: Paid at date for the payroll. (Date of the employer's payment).

paymentId.description: The reference number of the payment after payment is made.

applicationId.description: Application id for invoicing etc. purposes.

messageThreadId.description: The MessageThread Id, if this payroll is referred in a message thread.

ApiListItemValidation.description:
ApiValidation object that is specialized for list items.
Provides if and index properties for connecting a validation to a specific item in the list

id.description:
Identifier of the item this validation is for.
Identifiers are not always available (if the item has not been saved), so index is a more generic approach.

index.description: Zero based index of the item this validation is for.

isValid.description: If true, the data is valid - no errors.

hasAllRequiredFields.description: If true, has required fields missing data.

errors.description:
Validation errors on invalid field values. 
Note that required fields missing error messages are not here. Only the invalid values.

recurrenceRules.description: Gets or sets the recurrence rules to set the recurrence.

actionRules.description: For a recurring event, gets or sets the rules for the recurring actions

InvoicePreview.description:
Provides a preview of how an invoice should be created.
In the future versions, it is expected to return DIFF information on how
potential previously created invoices would behave (e.g. if som invoices would be canceled or changed).

MessageThread.description: Messages thread groups togehter a set of related messages and/or attachments.

otherParty.description:
Palkkaus.fi id (IBAN) of the other party.
The other party is the second entity(besides the owner) in that is juridically in the message.
This may or may not be the originator the message thread.
It is typically the Partner or Palkkaus.fi, but may also be the Worker in the future.

messages.description: List of messages and attachments in this thread

createdAt.description: The date when the object was created.

updatedAt.description:
The time when the object was last updated.

isReadOnly.description: Indication that for the currently logged-in account, the data is generally read-only.

partner.description: Primary partner information. Automatically updated from the storage container Partner.

Message.description: A message within a messaging thread.

content.description:
Textual content: If message, this is the content text.
If other type, short title / description typically shown in the title bar.

contentId.description:
Identifier of the external content.
BlobFile Id for attachments, Calculation ID for calculations etc.

contentData.description:
Other misc. data that is used in displaying the content in the immediate message view.
Do not include the entire object here. Just the immediately available data.

preview.description:
Content type specific text for preview.
This may be URI, ID or boolean.
For BlobFile, it is currently the BlobFile Guid (the same as ContentId) or null, 
but in the future, the field may also contain an URL without that being a breaking change!

readByOwner.description: If set, specifies the time when the message has been read by the thread owner.

readByOtherParty.description: If set, specifies the time when the message has been read by the other party.

MessageThreadWorkflow.description: Defines workflow actions for a message thread.

unreadCount.description: Number of messages that this party has posted that have not been read by the other party.

salaryDate.description:
The salary date for the discussion.
Owner's and other party's are typically the same, but they may differ: 
e.g. one may be the requested / estimated date and the other the first possible date if the requested is unrealistic.
NOTE: Unlike in Salaxy, this is always UTC.

updatedAt.description:
Time of the last message posted by this party. 
NOTE: Unlike in Salaxy, this is always UTC.

lastMessageText.description: Text for the last message (written by this party). This is for preview purposes: May be shortened.

MessageListItem.description:
Represents a single item in a list of message threads in the user interface.
It contains header data of the message thread and is basis for searching, filtering and sorting.

createdAt.description: The date when the object was created.

updatedAt.description:
The time when the object was last updated. 
Typically this should be a logical update by user (UserUpdatedAt in DTO), not technical updates.

endAt.description:

grossSalary.description: Gross salary if that is relevant to the transaction.

payment.description:

Total payment for the Employer and Net salary for the Worker in the case of a calculation.

fee.description: Estimated fee of the transaction to Palkkaus.fi.

shortText.description: A very short description describing the object as an event. E.g. "Paid salary"

businessObjects.description: Business object ids related to this object. E.g. calculations and payrolls in the payment.

versionNumber.description: Version number. May be used in conflicts

messages.description:

entityType.description: Sub category for the payload. E.g. Payment Category, MoneyTransfer Source.

logicalDate.description: The date for the actual period for which this object is done.

reference.description: Reference information. E.g. Payment or MoneyTransfer reference number.

externalId.description: External id for the object in 3rd party system.

partnerMessageAssignedTo.description: Contains the email or id of the responsible for the partner workflow event.

usecaseUri.description:

For now, just use a unique string starting with a domain you own.

Onboarding.description:
Provides the data for onboarding process for a company.
Onboarding is the process where Salaxy gathers sufficient information to at least create an acccount,
often even more so that the user can pay a salaary with the account.

Partner that should be added as primary authorization when the object is created.
Currently not used in update operations (only New and Signature / VismaSign)
and does not set as primary partner except if exception specifically made for a partner.

appState.description:
Custom state object that is guaranteed to survive the round-trip in the onboarding process.
Calling application to the onboarding may pass here any data that it needs after the onboarding process is ready and user has been authenticated.

updatedAt.description:

InvoiceStatusNotification.description: Contents for the invoice status notification message.

id.description:
Unique ID for the invoice in Salaxy system.
If omitted, the resolving to an invoice will be made using external id.

externalId.description:
External id can be set in the notification for the invoice for later messaging.
If the notification message contains an External Id AND regular Id, the External Id is updated in the Salaxy database.
If the notification contains External Id, but NO regular Id, an invoice is fetched based on External Id.
In the latter case, a non-existent Id or multiple invoices with the same External Id will throw an exception and the entire update process is canceled.

date.description: Required Date for the transaction (booking date).

amount.description: Required realized amount of the transaction.

receiverFullName.description: Optional full name of the payment receiver. Should be sent only if the user or process has the possibility of changing the name.

receiverIban.description: Optional bank account IBAN of the receiver. Should be sent only if the user or process has the possibility of changing the IBAN.

referenceNumber.description:
Optional payment reference number. Should be sent only if the user or process has the possibility of changing or removing the reference number.
Changing the reference number will typically lead to an error in the back office process that needs to be manually handled.

externalStatusAt.description: Invoice/payment status in the external system.

externalStatus.description: External status of the invoice in the external system.

isPaid.description: If true, the absence is paid by the employer.

isHolidayAccrual.description:
If true, annual leaves are accrued from the absence. If false, these days are deducted from the accrual.
By default, you may leave this null and it always follows the IsPaid.

iss.description:
REQUIRED. Issuer Identifier for the Issuer of the response. 
The iss value is a case-sensitive URL using the https scheme that contains scheme, host, and optionally, port number and path components and no query or fragment components.

aud.description:
In Salaxy federation this should be the federation endpoint: "https://secure.salaxy.com/security/federation" in production
OR "https://test-api.salaxy.com/security/federation" in the test environment.
From the spec: REQUIRED. Audience(s) that this ID Token is intended for. 
It MUST contain the OAuth 2.0 client_id of the Relying Party as an audience value. 
It MAY also contain identifiers for other audiences.
In the general case, the aud value is an array of case-sensitive strings.
In the common special case when there is one audience, the aud value MAY be a single case-sensitive string.

exp.description:
REQUIRED. Expiration time on or after which the ID Token MUST NOT be accepted for processing. 
The processing of this parameter requires that the current date/time MUST be before the expiration date/time listed in the value.
Implementers MAY provide for some small leeway, usually no more than a few minutes, to account for clock skew. 
Its value is a JSON [RFC7159] number representing the number of seconds from 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z as measured in UTC until the date/time.
See RFC 3339 [RFC3339] for details regarding date/times in general and UTC in particular.

sub.description: REQUIRED. Subject - Identifier for the End-User at the Issuer.

name.description:
End-User's full name in displayable form including all name parts, possibly including titles and suffixes, 
ordered according to the End-User's locale and preferences.
NOTE: In creating account etc., Salaxy will use given_name and family_name separately and therefore ignore the name.

given_name.description: Given name(s) or first name(s) of the End-User.

family_name.description: Surname(s) or last name(s) of the End-User.

picture.description:
URL of the End-User's profile picture.
This URL MUST refer to an image file (for example, a PNG, JPEG, or GIF image file), rather than to a Web page containing an image.

email.description:
End-User's preferred e-mail address.
Its value MUST conform to the RFC 5322 [RFC5322] addr-spec syntax.
The RP MUST NOT rely upon this value being unique, as discussed in Section 2.5.3.

email_verified.description:
True if the End-User's e-mail address has been verified; otherwise false. 
IMPORTANT: In Salaxy federation context, avoid sending non-confirmed e-mails. This may later become an error without being considered a breaking change.
When this Claim Value is true, this means that the OP took affirmative steps to ensure that this e-mail address was controlled by the End-User at the time the verification was performed. 
The means by which an e-mail address is verified is context specific, and dependent upon the trust framework or contractual agreements within which the parties are operating.

birthdate.description:
End-User's birthday, represented as an ISO 8601:2004 [ISO8601‑2004] YYYY-MM-DD format.
The year MAY be 0000, indicating that it is omitted.
To represent only the year, YYYY format is allowed.
Note that depending on the underlying platform's date related function, providing just year can result in varying month and day, so the implementers need to take this factor into account to correctly process the dates.

locale.description:
End-User's locale, represented as a BCP47 [RFC5646] language tag.
This is typically an ISO 639-1 Alpha-2 [ISO639‑1] language code in lowercase and an ISO 3166-1 Alpha-2 [ISO3166‑1] country code in uppercase, separated by a dash.
For example, en-US or fr-CA.

phone_number.description:
End-User's preferred telephone number. E.164 [E.164] is RECOMMENDED as the format of this Claim, for example, +1 (425) 555-1212 or +56 (2) 687 2400.
If the phone number contains an extension, it is RECOMMENDED that the extension be represented using the RFC 3966 [RFC3966] extension syntax, for example, +1 (604) 555-1234;ext=5678.

phone_number_verified.description:
True if the End-User's phone number has been verified; otherwise false.
When this Claim Value is true, this means that the OP took affirmative steps to ensure that this phone number was controlled by the End-User at the time the verification was performed.
The means by which a phone number is verified is context specific, and dependent upon the trust framework or contractual agreements within which the parties are operating.
When true, the phone_number Claim MUST be in E.164 format and any extensions MUST be represented in RFC 3966 format.

updated_at.description:
Time the End-User's information was last updated.
Its value is a JSON number representing the number of seconds from 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z as measured in UTC until the date/time.

OpenIdUserInfoAddress.description:
The Address Claim represents a physical mailing address in OpenID Connect UserInfo response message.
This object is modeled according to: http://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-basic-1_0.html#AddressClaim

street_address.description: Full street address component, which MAY include house number, street name, Post Office Box, and multi-line extended street address information.

postal_code.description: Zip code or postal code component.

UserInfoCompanyAccount.description: Salaxy extension to Open ID claims for company federation.

as_company.description:
If true, the authorization is made for a company account. 
The root user claims are just for a current user acting in behalf of the company.
If false, the entire CompanyClaims object will be ignored.

business_id.description:
The Business ID (Y-tunnus / Business Identity Code) is a code given to businesses and organizations by the PRH or the Tax Administration. 
It consists of seven digits, a dash and a control mark, for example 1234567-8.
Alternative accepted formats incule international VAT number "FI12345678" or number without the dash: "12345678".

name.description:
Company name - the owner of the Salaxy account and shown in salary calculations, reports and invoices.
Typically this is the official full name of the company as in Business registry.

picture.description:
URL of the Company profile picture.
This URL MUST refer to an image file (for example, a PNG, JPEG, or GIF image file), rather than to a Web page containing an image. 
The URL SHOULD specifically reference a company logo picture (PNG preferred) and it should be a square. If not, it may be converted, cropped and/or extended.

email.description:
The company's preferred e-mail address in relation to salary payments.
Its value MUST conform to the RFC 5322 [RFC5322] addr-spec syntax.

email_verified.description:
True if the Company's e-mail address has been verified; otherwise false.
IMPORTANT: In Salaxy federation context, avoid sending non-confirmed e-mails. This may later become an error without being considered a breaking change.
When this Claim Value is true, this means that the OP took affirmative steps to ensure that this e-mail address was controlled by the End-User at the time the verification was performed. 
The means by which an e-mail address is verified is context specific, and dependent upon the trust framework or contractual agreements within which the parties are operating.

phone_number.description:
Company's preferred telephone number for salary payment purposes. 
E.164 [E.164] is RECOMMENDED as the format of this Claim, for example, +1 (425) 555-1212 or +56 (2) 687 2400.
If the phone number contains an extension, it is RECOMMENDED that the extension be represented using the RFC 3966 [RFC3966] extension syntax, for example, +1 (604) 555-1234;ext=5678.

phone_number_verified.description:
True if the Company's phone number has been verified; otherwise false.
When this Claim Value is true, this means that the OP took affirmative steps to ensure that this phone number was controlled by the End-User at the time the verification was performed.
The means by which a phone number is verified is context specific, and dependent upon the trust framework or contractual agreements within which the parties are operating.
When true, the phone_number Claim MUST be in E.164 format and any extensions MUST be represented in RFC 3966 format.

proxy_partner.description:

Please note, that the calling account must have the authorization to the primary partner account, or
be the primary partner itself.

personal_id.description:
